conversation.message: That's an interesting distinction. So, you're essentially finding the most probable next word or phrase in a sequence?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Precisely! You've captured the core of how I generate responses quite accurately.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
